COMPOSITION
The template offers 7 slots covering hero, features, stats, content-image, and CTA layouts across a balanced dark/neutral/light progression. The markdown content maps naturally across these slots: key domain metrics fit the stats blocks, the 3-item wine overview maps cleanly to the 3-column stats/cards layout, and the viticulture principles fit the features list structure. The closing commercial and visiting details lead seamlessly into the final CTA section.
